text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day in the plaza, I spot Air Groove sitting with her shoulders slumped dejectedly. I approach her, but…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: This doesn't concern you. Don't stick your nose where it doesn't belong.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I didn't pay enough attention to some of my flowers, so they withered away.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I can't believe I allowed myself to become this lax. What's gotten into me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove's mood doesn't improve for a while.
